data.title: 初音未来 · 唱片店
data.description: 黑胶唱片店的试听台前，初音穿青蓝针织背心、奶油白短袖衬衫和靛蓝阔腿裤。她把耳机从头上取下，左手稳住头梁，右手把可转动耳罩朝右侧同行者的耳边递去，笑着分享刚听到的旋律。近处唱盘的唱臂与黑胶沟纹清楚可见，唱片套靠在台边；身后分类唱片木箱接向更远的壁架，试听台侧面露出放大器和卷好的线缆。左上店灯在唱盘与耳罩塑料上留下窄高光，前方橱窗柔光补亮两人的脸——「Master 快听！这首老黑胶唱片的音质有一种非常特别的温暖感，能激发我好多好多创作灵感呢！」
data.location: 复古唱片店试听台，分类木箱与壁架向后延伸
data.action: 取下耳机后，左手稳住头梁，右手转动耳罩并向右侧衣着完整的同行者分享试听。
data.lighting: warm shop light from the upper left with soft storefront fill on both faces
data.camera: medium two-shot, eye level, landscape view of headphones, turntable and listening pair
data.promptProse: One movable earcup turns toward the clothed listener standing to Miku's right at the vinyl shop's listening deck. Miku has lifted the headphones off her head, holding the band in her left hand while her right guides the cup close to the listener's ear. Her petrol-blue vest, cream collared shirt and indigo trousers give the outing a relaxed retro look beneath long teal twintails. In the foreground, the tonearm hovers over the record grooves and a sleeve leans against the deck. Classified wooden record bins lead to the wall shelves behind them; an amplifier and coiled cable sit below the side of the station. Use an eye-level landscape medium two-shot with separate faces and hand contacts. Warm light from the upper left draws narrow highlights on vinyl and headphone plastic. Storefront fill keeps both faces clear above the darker shelf rows.
